name: selftest_h3_vae

inputs.clip: h3_vae_tiny.clip(frames, height, width, seed): (1, 3, T, H, W) in [-1, 1]; an image is clip(1, height, width, seed)
inputs.seeded_latents: numpy default_rng(seed).standard_normal((1, 24, T, H, W)) in float32, drawn in the order of cases['latents']
inputs.latents: the class's encode: (mean - latents_mean) / latents_std, (1, 24, T, H, W)
inputs.decoded: the class's decode: (1, 3, T, H, W) float32 in [0, 1]
inputs.tiny: TAEHV(latent_channels=24).decode of each fp32 latent: (1, 3, T, H, W) in [0, 1]
inputs.weights: h3_vae_tiny.weights(shapes[role]) written by h3_vae_tiny.write_safetensors as F32

oracle.f16_math: each linear, convolution, norm and attention in float32 over float16 operands, one float16 rounding

tolerances.rule: against the float64 result: fp32 relative L2 at twice the oracle's own fp32 relative L2; float16 decode PSNR at the oracle's own float16 PSNR less 20 log10(2) dB; float16 encode relative L2 at twice the oracle's own float16 relative L2

notes: Each model is a ComfyUI class at a tiny size with seeded weights, so the numbers say nothing about image or audio quality.
